question: Can you provide a list of hardware product segments along with their unique product counts for 2020 in the output, ordered by the highest percentage increase in unique fact sales products from 2020 to 2021?
sql:
WITH sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.segment,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hfs.product_code) AS unique_products_2020
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly hfs
    JOIN hardware_dim_product dp ON hfs.product_code = dp.product_code
    WHERE hfs.fiscal_year = 2020
    GROUP BY dp.segment
),
sales_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.segment,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hfs.product_code) AS unique_products_2021
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly hfs
    JOIN hardware_dim_product dp ON hfs.product_code = dp.product_code
    WHERE hfs.fiscal_year = 2021
    GROUP BY dp.segment
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(s2020.segment, s2021.segment) AS segment,
    COALESCE(s2020.unique_products_2020, 0) AS unique_products_2020,
    COALESCE(s2021.unique_products_2021, 0) AS unique_products_2021
FROM sales_2020 s2020
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_2021 s2021 ON s2020.segment = s2021.segment
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(s2020.unique_products_2020, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 1.0 * (COALESCE(s2021.unique_products_2021, 0) - COALESCE(s2020.unique_products_2020, 0)) / COALESCE(s2020.unique_products_2020, 0) * 100
    END DESC;

FULL OUTER JOIN sales_2021 s2021 ON s2020.segment = s2021.segment
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(s2020.unique_products_2020, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 1.0 * (COALESCE(s2021.unique_products_2021, 0) - COALESCE(s2020.unique_products_2020, 0)) / COALESCE(s2020.unique_products_2020, 0) * 100
    END DESC;
